title: Bar Payuli
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He removed forbidden fats and sinews from meat in Shmuel's time. As related in [Chullin 96a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.96a.7-8), he was standing before Mar Shmuel, trimming a thigh; he became frightened and the knife fell from his hand, etc.[^1][^2]

notes.text: אטמא means thigh. The task is removing forbidden fats and sinews, and the knife falls after he is frightened.

The linked passage names Bar Payolei and describes removing the sciatic nerve from a thigh. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2949&lang=en) cites this incident, reporting that Rashi understands the words as a name and that the Arukh gives alternative explanations.
